BiblicalUsage: Eder is a Benjamite, son of Beriah, named once in the genealogy of the tribe of Benjamin. His name means flock, and the list calls him a chief of the inhabitants of Aijalon, but the Bible tells us nothing more about his life. He stands in the record as one of the heads of a family in Israel.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the heads of families matter to God even when their stories are short, because the people of God is built from households like his. Eder's name is kept, and that is enough.
